_comment: Human adjudication of gradings the automated matcher could not settle. Keyed by question text; each value is one label, or a list of labels when the 3B and 7B models gave different answers. 'pred' records the model output a label was judged against, and a label is applied only when the run produces exactly that prediction, so a label never silently carries over to a different answer. 'models' says which runs produced it. Proposed by Claude: every non-exact-match answer in the 3B and 7B n=1000 runs was reviewed (2026-11-04) and only verdicts that differ from bioasq.grade() are stored. Entries whose note starts JUDGEMENT CALL are not simple synonym matches: the answer is less specific than the gold, phrased indirectly, or right where the gold is wrong or outdated. All were re-checked against the rubric on 2026-11-04; a biomedical expert may still disagree with individual calls.
